title: Pronunciation overrides (foundation §5.4)
description: Two lists: the SDK's global speech/overrides.en.json and a game's content/pronunciations.json (the game's wins). Keys are whole words, matched case-insensitively, applied after toSpeakable rule 1 (straighten quotes) and before rules 2–13. `say` is always required — Zira cannot read Kokoro phonemes. NOTE: the existing Blanks lexicon (games/blanks/content/pronounce.json) uses {ipa, say, spell} and per-card entries; F6 decides whether it migrates to this shape or this shape grows `ipa`/`spell` (see FOUNDATION-AUDIT).

say.description: Plain respelling every voice can read: "Wuss-ter-sher".

phonemes.description: Kokoro phonemes (espeak notation); used by the Kokoro voices, `say` by the rest.
